pr.title: Gate phase completion on BRC consensus in clean-exit path
pr.description:
Fix bug where _run_concurrent_phase returns success when all containers
exit cleanly (code 0) but BRC consensus was never reached. Adds a final
consensus recheck in the no-failures exit path, mirroring the existing
pattern in the has_failures branch.

Closes #1581
